goal: Add the OP_CAT opcode to Tapscript to enable byte and string concatenation in Bitcoin smart contracts
Allow developers to evaluate and test OP_CAT behavior on test networks ahead of any activation consensus
reviewability: Review may wait a long time for a response because the author has been silent for 172 days
agreement: Blocking objection: cannot merge a consensus opcode change without community consensus (achow101)
Unaddressed objection: disabled OP_CAT bypasses policy rejection with DISCOURAGE_OP_SUCCESS (Yudis-bit)
Unaddressed objection: test loop logic skips checking element sizes above 260 bytes (Yudis-bit)
Nonblocking objection: standard limit allows unintended introspection via stack templates (moonsettler)
Support for merging OP_CAT (EthanHeilman), but an approval without rationale is discounted (awin28522)

categories.name: validation
why: P2 because it implements the interpreter logic for BIP-347 OP_CAT, a major proposed Tapscript soft fork
It gives script developers long-sought string and byte concatenation capabilities on the stack
It deliberately omits activation logic and fixes no active defect, making it strategic rather than urgent
